title: Feel n' Flow
description: extra immersive minecraft to just feel n' flow with it
body:
![feel n' flow it](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1d689ad39d86318a502b357cd273fa67cd6c99e7.jpeg)

# 
![why feel n' flow?](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1efc702e5943fb5720745376265f42d2ca5a744c.png)

Do you want **MINECRAFT** to look much more **beautiful** and **immersive**?

_**Then you’ve come to the right place.**_ 

Version 1.21.5 with **excellent mods** and **amazing resource packs** makes minecraft **better than ever**.

# 
![perfect combination](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/af764683230d0391f93e0ccb9282f9beab0fd5ed.png)

- **Geophilic** and **Cliff Face** provide **perfect world generation**.

- A variety of mods add a **sense of engagement** to the gameplay like **never before**!

- Resource packs deliver a **perfect visual experience** and **animated mobs**.

- The **best shaders** with _custom presets_!

- I did my best to _optimize_ it as much _as possible_ :/ 
(If you have problems with fps ~~remove~~ Whimscape Leaves ~20fps)

# 
![main mods](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ee4b7538e1eac4420be46aef64af350ce1a58498.png)

Auto HUD - **Camera Overhaul** - Chalk - Better Clouds - **Fancy Block Particles** - Blasting Plus - Cliff Face - **Farmer's Delight** - Extended block shapes - **Geophilic** - **Hold My Items** - Minecraft Cursor - Not Enough Animations - **Particular** - Particle Rain - **Sounds** - **Subtle Effects** - Visuality - YDM's Weapon Master - **Ambient Sounds**

# 
![main resource packs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/30a831ea768af44639a6467ca0eb223b290a20bf.png)

3D Tools and Utils - **Actually 3D Stuff** - **Fresh Animations** - **Fresh Food** - **Visual Effects+** - **Whimscape** - ToolTips Stylized 

# 
![what's next?](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9d276b967ad59ece44eee40418ebc00475437a7b.png)

The modpack **will be updated** at _my discretion_ or _if bugs appear_ :)
